thread:
eli: Heads up — seeing a pattern of intermittent PCI/IO latency spikes in us-east-1f GPU hosts starting ~22:05 UTC. Attach times for container GPUs jumping to 8-12s, memory mapping errors in dmesg. Not a full outage but affects new pod scheduling and some model warmups.

maria: Copy. Any impacted customer-facing services yet?

eli: So far just backend warmups and batch jobs. Real-time inference (hosted API) fallback kept latency in check via routing, but we saw a few 5xx retries from a canary.

jamal: Can you paste the node list and recent taints? thinking we should soft-cordon the affected rack and shift new scheduling away until we confirm root cause.

eli: Quick dump: ```kubectl get nodes -l zone=us-east-1f -o wide
node-ue1f-01 READY  32Gi  gpu:4  age 120d  10.10.1.5
node-ue1f-02 READY  32Gi  gpu:4  age 98d   10.10.1.6
node-ue1f-03 Ready  32Gi  gpu:4  age 10d   10.10.1.7
```
and tail of dmesg: ```[  345.123456] NVRM: GPU at 0000:06:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:06): 79, pid 2041, GPU has fallen off.
[  345.123789] pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Multiple Uncorrected error received
```

zoe: Looks like AER/PCIe flapping on that pcie root. Could be switch firmware or NIC. ops-lead, do we have a maintenance window to patch the top-of-rack?

ops-lead: Not a scheduled window. Prefer to avoid rolling infra during peak. Suggest a controlled soft-cordon + migrate noncritical workloads first. We'll open a ticket with cloud provider on NIC firmware but need mitigation immediately.

jamal: Plan suggestion: 1) Taint the three nodes with `infra-evac=soft:NoSchedule` so existing pods stay but no new pod attaches. 2) Kick a gradual eviction of batch jobs and non-prod pods with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60` on each host, one at a time. 3) Keep a small canary in the pool to observe if errors follow the node during evacuate. 4) Enable routing weight shift from us-east-1f to us-east-1b/c for new requests.

infra-automation: Running `taint_nodes.py --zone us-east-1f --taint infra-evac=soft:NoSchedule` now (dry-run first).

oncall-bot: Alert: 3 events in us-east-1f NIC/AER detected between 22:05-22:12 UTC. Pager duty: infra-oncall.

eli: Doing the taint dry-run output: ```Would taint nodes: node-ue1f-01 node-ue1f-02 node-ue1f-03
Proceed? yes
Taint applied to node-ue1f-01
Taint applied to node-ue1f-02
Taint applied to node-ue1f-03```

maria: After taint, start draining node-ue1f-03 first (youngest, less warmed GPUs). Move noncritical replica sets and batch queues. Keep `maxUnavailable=1` for prod deployments.

jamal: Also set autoscaler override to avoid scaling into tainted zone: `cluster-autoscaler --skip-nodes-with-force=true` and patch node group config to prefer other AZs for new scale-ups.

zoe: Cost tradeoff note: pushing traffic to other AZs increases cross-AZ egress and might raise costs for replicated caches. Ops-lead, do we accept short-term egress/cpu cost to preserve SLA?

ops-lead: Yes — prefer slight cost bump over customer impact. Documenting decision and pre-approving up to 30% excess egress for the next 4 hours.

eli: Drain sequence started on node-ue1f-03. Evicted 12 batch pods, 2 noncritical replicas. Watching per-token latency for hosted-api canary.

infra-automation: Eviction script outputs: `Evicted pods: batch-job-382, retrain-enc-5, nightly-embed-1...` 15 total. Node under observation.

jamal: If errors continue after draining all nodes, next is to fence at hypervisor: stop VM, reprovision NIC, then bring back with fresh firmware. Coordinate with cloud provider tech support.

eli: Canary metrics: new attach latencies dropped to normal on shifted nodes, no new AER events on drained hosts for 12m. Proceeding to drain the other two nodes sequentially with 10m observation windows.

maria: Good. Please keep incident channel updated and add brief postmortem note re: suspected PCIe root error and follow-up with vendor for firmware. Also check for correlated maint events in provider logs.

ops-lead: Noted. Creating incident ticket INC-2025-1432, linking this thread. Will schedule patch window with provider once we have repro steps.

eli: Thanks team — will post status updates in 10m or on any regression. :white_check_mark:
